Atlas of Cities

Hover a country, island, county, sea, lake, river or canal to learn more. Cities appear on land. Drag or scroll sideways to go round the globe.

Try
Key

      Each country has its own colour, set by land area: similar-sized countries get similar colours. States, provinces and counties share their country's colour. Thick grey lines mark England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

      Boundaries, continents and city data from Natural Earth (public domain), which follows its own default view of disputed borders. UK counties are Natural Earth's local authority areas, and where the data lists no city inside one, the nearest are shown instead. Water bodies are also from Natural Earth. Six canals are drawn by hand along their known routes, so their course is approximate. Country populations are Natural Earth estimates, mostly from 2019 to 2021, and areas are calculated from the map outlines, so both are approximate. City figures are metro-area population estimates, shown to the nearest thousand or million.
